Support

If you run into a problem or have a suggestion, please write to us by email.

Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com

We aim to reply within a few business days.

Helpful details to include

  • Your device model and operating system version
  • The App version
  • What was happening when the problem occurred, with a screenshot if you have one

Frequently asked questions

Is Sunmeld out yet?

Not yet. Sunmeld is in development for iOS and Android. Store badges on this site are placeholders until then.

Is it free?

Sunmeld is free to try, and a single purchase unlocks everything. There are no ads.

Do you collect personal information?

The Sunmeld app collects none. This website collects basic visit statistics through Google Analytics (see the Privacy Policy for details), and has no accounts or ads.
